entry.summary: Visa-free short stays as part of the Schengen area.
entry.max_stay: 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen area
entry.pre_arrival: None today. ETIAS is on the watch list.
entry.other: Schengen Entry/Exit System: fingerprints and photo at the border on first entry (free, nothing to do beforehand). Get an entry stamp where one is still given, and carry your passport across internal borders.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The official currency of Malta is the Euro. You need to declare if you are travelling with 10,000 euros or more when entering, transiting or exiting Malta. This applies to all forms of currency. If you don't declare your money or give incorrect information, you'll be fined.

laws.rule: You can use your Australian driver's licence to drive for one year from arrival (digital driver's licences may not be accepted). If you plan to live in Malta for more than one year, you must exchange your Australian licence for a Maltese licence.

tourism.detail: Visa-free short stays as part of the Schengen area.

meetings.detail: Business meetings are covered, without being employed in the country.

conference.detail: Business travel, including conferences, is covered.

unpaid-speaking.detail: Unpaid speaking during a business visit is generally covered; the paid-activity exclusion is read narrowly.
unpaid-speaking.next: If unsure, ask High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

paid-speaking.detail: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.
paid-speaking.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

ai-teaching.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

remote-work.detail: Remote work for an employer outside the EU isn't addressed in the EU guidance read.
remote-work.next: Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

entrepreneur.detail: Exploring and meeting fit a business visit; running a business needs national permission.
entrepreneur.next: Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

trade.detail: Business visits are covered; selling or delivering services may be paid activity.
trade.next: Keep the trip to meetings and negotiation.

artist.detail: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.
artist.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

mixed-mission.detail: The visa-free stay covers the business and tourism parts; any paid part needs national permission.
mixed-mission.next: Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.

filming.route: Visa-free Schengen short stay (journalistic or media purposes)
filming.detail: Journalistic or media purposes are listed among visa-free purposes; paid production work and location permits are national matters.
filming.next: Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley about filming, and the local authority about locations.

research.route: Visa-free Schengen short stay (short-term study or training)
research.detail: Short-term study and training are covered; paid research at an institution is paid activity.
research.next: Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley if the host pays you.

volunteering.detail: Volunteering isn't addressed in the EU guidance read.
volunteering.next: Ask the High Commission of Malta, O'Malley.
